A free choice needs existence entailed or itself a legitimate choice (5.2). The WIDEZONE-07 and 10.a bounds are own-involvement and no longer reach. Only NON_CLAIMED declarations reach S5, so 4.4(3) gives INVENTED.

As L25. AM-10 itself survives: a position may be filled inside assumed bounds because existence is already entailed. Here existence is no longer entailed, so the premise of AM-10 fails and the stated 0-40 m has no support.

The bar was Wide Zone's own NOT_AUTHORED declaration on S6 [noun=channel], scoped OWN_INVOLVEMENT; under AM-13 it reaches no element, as do items 04.a, 05.a, 06 and 10.b. As L26. This is the change most sensitive to how declaration scope is read: it holds only if an own-involvement declaration covers the same (now empty) unit as an own-involvement item, which the grammar sheet's 'a declaration may carry a selector and scope, like an item' supports.

asAuthored.summary: Nothing authored makes scoring worth most centrally. Every authored spatial value-weighter weights WIDE, FORWARD, SWITCH or BLIND-SIDE. The central-weighting text lives only in slot-mechanics-variations.ts and its coach-voice translation: ENGINE_ONLY under RC-10/SD-21, inert under spec s3, forward result 'inert' under s7. So as authored this contract can collide with nothing.

result.whatWouldBeMissed: That V8b's per-referent structure makes the UNION the default outcome, so central x2 and Wide Zone coexist with every line green and the wide incentive dead. That mod-wide is already NOT_AUTHORED, so any collision reported on it rests on an unauthored element. That AM-05 turns a second modifier into a support failure for BOTH. result.coachFacingConsequence: A coach could be handed a game where scoring counts double in the wide channels and double through the middle, with every audit line green. The whole point of Wide Zone Advantage - that wide is worth more than central - is gone, and nothing reports it. The failure mode here is silent acceptance, not a false UNRESOLVED.

consolidated.asAuthoredOutcome: Nothing collides, and neither agent gives the first reason. No item in the eight restated contracts mentions central value at all: the weighting exists only in engine code. The game holds one V7 element, mod-wide, and central-corridor carries no value row. No central item, no central value line, nothing for SD-21 inertness to bite on. The corridor exists and is worth nothing.
consolidated.asIfAuthoredOutcome: Still no collision, and on Christian's own adopted rule. AM-11 (spec s5): "Explicit each means one requirement per member." WIDEZONE-11.a says "each a referent", so V8b items bind the member they name; CW-H-05 names central-corridor and never reaches L185/L186. Read the deriver's way, 11.a would demand channel-south on L185 and collide with itself. Reviewer upheld.

The deriver's own note concedes its premise: "sole" is unenforceable because s4.3 checks cardinality only on EXISTS/COUNT/RANGE. A collision built on an unenforceable clause is not derivable.

whereItSurfaces.line: spec s1 vs s4.1; grammar sheet line 45
whereItSurfaces.detail: s1 makes one line per member. s4.1 matches on row plus element selector only. The grammar sheet: "An item on a FIELD row applies to every element that satisfies its selector." Nothing maps an item onto a member. AM-11 settles it by implication; the text never says it. That wording is mine to fix, not his.

whereItSurfaces.detail: 117 ENTAILED, 246 NOT_AUTHORED, 47 INVENTED, 6 NARROWED_CHOICE, 4 FREE(b). Exactly one non-none collision field, L160, resolved by set intersection. Game ledger entry 18 records dangling references to "collision 7" and "collision 8" that flaggedCollisions never held.

whereItSurfaces.stage: Why the contradiction is inexpressible
whereItSurfaces.line: register rows V7-V10; grammar sheet s3
whereItSurfaces.detail: Requirement kinds are closed - EQUALS, RANGE, COUNT, EXISTS, NOT_EXISTS, POSITIONED, ORIENTED - all absolute and per element. "Wide is worth more than central" compares two modifiers and has no row and no requirement kind. coach-voice.ts:209 ships that exact comparative to coaches.

whereItSurfaces.stage: Side risk: AM-13 empties OWN_INVOLVEMENT
whereItSurfaces.detail: Every Wide Zone region item is OWN_INVOLVEMENT. AM-13 fixes that scope to elements entailed by the contract's other-scoped items, and no Wide Zone WHOLE_GAME item entails a region, so the scope is empty. Stage D gave L21/L22/L23 ENTAILED from 02.a/03/08.d under the older rules. Nobody has re-run this.

whereItSurfaces.stage: For Christian - the only thing that is his
whereItSurfaces.result: May a contract author a comparative value claim?
whereItSurfaces.detail: That is the knowledge at stake: wide is worth more than central. The grammar cannot hold it, and Wide Zone's ledger records that it considered the S6 exclusion proxy and declined. Yes: it needs a row and I design it. No: mutual exclusion is a contract-authoring duty via an EXCLUSION item, and I write that into the grammar sheet. Everything else above is mine.

consolidated.whatWouldBeMissed: The union: name central-corridor an additional referent on mod-wide and every line reads entailed while Wide Zone's whole point is gone. That membership disagreements can never be collisions at all. That a second modifier unsupports the first (AM-05). That the comparative "wide beats central" has no row. And that WIDEZONE-09, the only item about central space, was never placed.
